notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing it.
When Bloodflow Connoisseur dies, Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Bloodflow Connoisseur from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodflow Connoisseur enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
